items.name: Congo
facts: Deepest river; second-largest by discharge.
Africa’s second-longest river.
Forms stretches of the Republic of the Congo–DRC border.

items.name: Ubangi
items.fact: Forms much of the CAR–DRC border.
facts: Forms much of the CAR–DRC border.

items.name: Kasai
items.fact: Major left-bank tributary of the Congo.
facts: Major left-bank tributary of the Congo.
Rises in Angola.

items.name: Sangha
items.fact: Congo tributary of Cameroon, CAR, and the Republic of the Congo.
facts: Congo tributary of Cameroon, CAR, and the Republic of the Congo.

items.name: Ogooué
facts: Principal river of Gabon.
Drains most of the country to the Atlantic.

items.name: Lake Tanganyika
facts: Longest freshwater lake; second-deepest.
An African Rift lake shared by four countries.

items.name: Lake Kivu
items.fact: Rift lake between Rwanda and the DRC.
facts: Rift lake between Rwanda and the DRC.

items.name: Lake Mai-Ndombe
items.fact: A large shallow lake in the western DRC.
facts: A large shallow lake in the western DRC.

items.name: Lake Mweru
items.fact: Shared by the DRC and Zambia.
facts: Shared by the DRC and Zambia.
Fed by the Luapula; drains via the Luvua to the Congo.

items.name: Lake Albert
items.fact: A source lake of the White Nile.
facts: A source lake of the White Nile.
Shared by Uganda and the DRC.
